app.name: Sgela
app.tagline: Step inside a career. Learn it. Prove it. Get invited in.

coach.comingSoon: Your AI Career Coach arrives soon.

home.title: Your Career Compass
home.body: Your personal career map will light up here once you claim your expo results.
home.bodyClaimed: Your expo worlds are saved. Your full career map, with next steps for these worlds, arrives soon.

explore.title: Explore career worlds
explore.body: Aviation, Engineering, Culinary, Medical and Agriculture are on their way.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Courses with 3D models and AR will appear here.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.body: Bursaries, learnerships and invites matched to you will appear here.

me.title: Me
me.body: Your profile, credentials and privacy settings.

sms.otp: Your Sgela code is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes. Never share it.
sms.guardianInvite: Hi {guardian}, {learner} joined Sgela, a free careers learning app by Veza. Please read and give consent here: {link}
sms.guardianReminder: Reminder: {learner} is waiting for your consent to use Sgela fully. Read and reply here: {link}

start.title: Save your results
start.intro: Sign up with your phone number. We will SMS you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
start.trustDevice: Keep me signed in on this phone for 30 days
start.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} s
start.doneRestricted: You can start learning now. Opportunities and invites open once your guardian says yes.
start.doneNoResults: Played at a Veza expo? Add your code any time from Me.

profile.title: About you
profile.schoolHint: Start typing to search. If your school is not listed, type its name.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a South African mobile number, e.g. 071 234 5678.
errors.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.
errors.codeWrong: That code is not right. {left} tries left.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.codeLocked: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.resendTooSoon: Please wait {seconds} s before asking again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many codes asked for. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.dobInvalid: Enter a real date of birth.
errors.tooYoung: You must be at least 10 years old to sign up.
errors.districtInvalid: Choose a district in your province.
errors.guardianSamePhone: Use the number of your parent or guardian, not your own.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

guardian.title: Your parent or guardian
guardian.intro: Because you are under 18, a parent or guardian must agree before we can match you with opportunities. We will send them a link.
guardian.name: Their name
guardian.sentNote: Until they agree you can learn, but sponsors cannot see you and you get no invites.

consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.intro: Choose how Sgela may use your information. You can change this any time in Me, Privacy and consent.
consent.PLATFORM: Use Sgela to learn and track my progress
consent.PLATFORMHelp: Needed to use the app. We keep your profile, progress and expo results.
consent.MATCHING: Match me with bursaries, learnerships and jobs
consent.MATCHINGHelp: We compare your profile with opportunities. Sponsors only see your details when you apply.
consent.PARTNER_CONTACT: Let partners contact me after I accept an invite
consent.MARKETINGHelp: Occasional SMS or WhatsApp. No spam.
consent.guardianIntro: {name} has joined Sgela, a free app by Veza that helps young South Africans explore careers, learn skills and find bursaries and jobs.
consent.guardianWhat1: Name, date of birth, phone number, province, district, school and grade, so we can show the right courses.
consent.guardianWhat2: Learning progress and VR expo results, so we can recommend next steps.
consent.guardianWhat3: We never sell data. Sponsors only see totals, unless {name} applies for an opportunity you allowed.
consent.guardianWhat4: You can withdraw consent at any time by contacting Veza.
consent.guardianThanks: Thank you. Your choice has been saved.
consent.guardianThanksDecline: {name} can still learn on Sgela but will not be matched with opportunities.
consent.invalidBody: It may have expired or been replaced by a newer SMS. Ask the learner to send it again from the app.
consent.guardianMATCHING: Match {name} with bursaries, learnerships and jobs
consent.guardianMATCHINGHelp: We compare the profile of {name} with opportunities. Sponsors only see details when {name} applies.
consent.guardianPARTNER_CONTACT: Let partners contact {name} after an invite is accepted

claim.heroMany: Welcome! You explored {count} career worlds today.
claim.subtitle: Save your results to unlock your Career Compass.
claim.invalidTitle: We could not find that code
claim.invalidBody: Check the code on your card or kiosk screen. You can still sign up and add it later.
claim.expiredBody: Codes last 30 days. You can still sign up and explore careers.
claim.usedTitle: This code was already used - ask a facilitator
claim.usedBody: Each code can be saved by one person only.
claim.mineTitle: These results are already saved to your account
claim.addIntro: Played at a Veza expo? Enter the 6-character code from your card.

me.restrictedBody: We sent {guardian} a link. Until they agree, you can learn but you will not get opportunity invites.

privacy.title: Privacy and consent
privacy.intro: These are your current choices. Each change is saved as a new record.
privacy.minorNote: Because you are under 18, only your guardian can switch these on. You can switch them off.
privacy.platformLocked: Needed to use Sgela. To stop using Sgela, ask us to delete your account.
